Evidence/VIS-REMITTANCE-COST
Evidence record

Quoted cost of sending US$200 and US$500 to Yemen from Saudi Arabia and the UAE, 2025 Q3

What does this evidence establish?

In 2025 Q3, the average quoted cost of sending US$200 from Saudi Arabia to Yemen was 2.70% of the amount sent, and 1.26% for US$500; from the United Arab Emirates (UAE) the averages were 7.53% and 5.62% respectively. These are averages of quotes for formal products listed by the World Bank Remittance Prices Worldwide database in two corridors; they are not a national Yemen remittance-cost average and do not cover all providers or informal channels.

What does it measure?

The total cost of sending US$200 or US$500 from Saudi Arabia or the United Arab Emirates to Yemen, as a percentage of the amount sent, averaged over quotes for formal products in 2025 Q3.

Who or what does it apply to?

Formal remittance products listed by the World Bank Remittance Prices Worldwide database for the Saudi Arabia–Yemen and United Arab Emirates–Yemen corridors, by send amount, 2025 Q3

When was it measured or observed?

2025 Q3

How current is it?

The averages refer to the third quarter of 2025. As checked on 26 September 2026, both corridor pages still showed the third quarter of 2025 as the latest quarter.

What this evidence does not establish

These averages cover two corridors, two send amounts and formal products listed by Remittance Prices Worldwide; they are not a national average cost of remittances to Yemen and do not represent all providers, all remittances or informal channels.

Limits of the measure

Each average is specific to its send amount and can vary by provider, payment instrument, receiving method, fee and exchange-rate margin; the number of providers and quotes behind it is not recorded in the evidence base.

Method and verification detailDetail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Averages published by the World Bank Remittance Prices Worldwide database on its Saudi Arabia–Yemen and United Arab Emirates–Yemen corridor pages ('Total Average', third quarter of 2025), for send amounts of US$200 and US$500, from standardized collection of provider price quotes.
